title: Scriptorium Project Record v1
description: One research project in the user-owned Markdown workspace. The reference adapter materializes it as Projects/<project_id>.md whose YAML frontmatter conforms to this schema; the body remains human-authored Markdown plus the separately owned append-only progress-log region. Obsidian is an optional editor. Provenance ingests supported frontmatter for portfolio and context retrieval without becoming the owner of the source file.

project_id.description: Stable kebab-case id; should match the repo dir name when there is one.

stage.description: Free-text current phase, e.g. 调研 / 数据 / 建模 / 写作 / 投稿修改.

next_actions.description: Concrete next steps; the portfolio dashboard surfaces these.

blocked_by.description: What blocks progress, empty if none.

linked_literature.description: Steward item keys or collection paths (the literature this project draws on).

linked_repo.description: Absolute local path used to resolve agent sessions to this project; normally the project's code repo, or the Markdown workspace when no separate repo is selected.

linked_conversations.description: Provenance attribution key (usually the repo dir name) so the hub can tie this project's AI sessions to it.
